items.title: He Only Throws Fastballs. Hitters Still Can’t Guess What’s Coming.
items.content_text: In an era where pitchers are throwing more breaking balls than ever, Cam Schlittler of the New York Yankees is dominating with 90% heaters.

items.title: Soccer’s ‘Special One’ Is Plotting One Last Coup
items.content_text: José Mourinho seemed to have fallen out of the European soccer elite. But after forgettable stops in Turkey and Portugal, he’s back in the limelight at Real Madrid.

items.title: Costco sells its dedicated members everything from travel packages to gasoline. Now it’s entering a big new market with its own Medicare plans.
items.content_text: In some markets, the retailer’s insurance products will integrate pharmacy, vision and hearing benefits.

items.title: Hayden Panettiere’s Tragic Quest to Outrun Her Child Stardom
items.content_text: The “Heroes” actress, who died Sunday at age 36, was open about the struggles that came with acting at a young age.

items.title: Americans Are Breaking Up With White Bed Sheets
items.content_text: Bedding brands and retailers report strong sales growth for printed sheets, as shoppers seek sets with more color, texture, and pattern.

items.title: The Sixth-Year College Quarterback Who Sued to Stay in School
items.content_text: Ole Miss quarterback Trinidad Chambliss set college football on fire last season. Then he fought a legal battle against the NCAA for the right to stay in the game.

items.title: AstraZeneca Ends Phase 3 Lung Cancer Drug Trial After Review
items.content_text: A committee said the volrustomig combination was unlikely to reach either of the primary endpoints for the trail, but the company said other Phase 3 volrustomig trials would continue as planned.

items.title: A mom had spent years wondering why her son wasn’t talking, walking and growing like most kids. An AI chatbot helped diagnose a rare bone disease.
items.content_text: Patients, doctors and nurses are turning to the technology for help identifying rare and undiagnosed diseases.

items.title: Eli Lilly Sues Sellers of Black Market Weight-Loss Drugs
items.content_text: Eli Lilly has filed six new lawsuits against U.S. entities that it alleges are selling a version of the company’s investigational weight-loss drug on the black market.

items.title: A young woman’s fatal overdose is a tragic part of a growing national debate over kratom, a multibillion-dollar, largely unregulated industry operating in the shadow of the opioid crisis
items.content_text: Kratom has been linked to overdoses and sparked some states to crack down on the unregulated substance.

items.title: President Trump signed a new executive order calling for most children to receive fewer vaccines and made extensive comments linking childhood shots and autism—something scientists say is unfounded
items.content_text: It is unusual, if not unprecedented, for detailed vaccine policy to emerge from the White House.
